nodes.description: Address of the vesting beneficiary that receives released tokens.
Constant month length in seconds (2629743) used to derive durations.
Cliff duration = _month * 6, set at declaration.
Linear release duration = _month * 5, set at declaration.
Absolute UNIX timestamp when the cliff ends (start + _cliffDuration).
Absolute UNIX timestamp when vesting starts.
ERC20 token contract being vested.
Timestamp of the last release, initialised to the cliff.
Mapping of token address to total amount already released.
MoraVesting constructor: validates beneficiary/duration/timestamps and initialises token, beneficiary, cliff, start and lastRelease.
Public view getter returning _beneficiary.
Public view getter returning _cliff.
Public view getter returning _start.
Public view getter returning _cliff + _releaseDuration.
Public view getter returning _released[address(_token)].
Public function that computes the releasable amount, updates _released and _lastRelease and transfers tokens to the beneficiary.
Private view function returning the vested amount minus what was already released when at least one month passed since the last release.
Private view function computing the total vested amount from the token balance and elapsed time since the cliff.
Miner-influenced block timestamp used for cliff, interval and vesting-progress checks.
External ERC20 call _token.safeTransfer(_beneficiary, unreleased) executed in release().
External ERC20 call _token.balanceOf(address(this)) executed in _vestedAmount().
Unchecked subtraction block.timestamp - _lastRelease in _releasableAmount() which can underflow.
Arithmetic block.timestamp.sub(_cliff) used to compute the linear vesting factor.
Arithmetic totalBalance.mul(elapsed).div(_releaseDuration) computing the vested proportion.
Arithmetic _released[address(_token)].add(unreleased) updating the released accounting.
Constructor parameter token: ERC20 token address to vest.
Constructor parameter beneficiary: address receiving vested tokens.
Constructor parameter start: vesting start timestamp.
Local variable unreleased in release(): amount returned by _releasableAmount().
Local variable currentBalance in _vestedAmount(): token balance held by the contract.
Local variable totalBalance in _vestedAmount(): currentBalance plus already released tokens.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token is used to build the token interface.
Constructor parameter beneficiary flows into the beneficiary validation and assignment.
Constructor parameter start flows into the timestamp validation and schedule setup.
Constructor assigns _token = IERC20(token).
Constructor assigns _beneficiary = beneficiary.
Constructor assigns _start = start.
Constructor computes _cliff = start.add(_cliffDuration).
Constructor initialises _lastRelease = _cliff.
_cliffDuration is added to start to derive the cliff.
_cliffDuration is derived from _month * 6.
_releaseDuration is derived from _month * 5.
Constructor requires start.add(_cliffDuration + _releaseDuration) > block.timestamp.
release() calls _releasableAmount() to obtain the amount due.
_releasableAmount() calls _vestedAmount() before subtracting released tokens.
release() gates execution on the miner-influenced block.timestamp versus _cliff.
release() stores the returned amount in the local unreleased.
release() increases _released[address(_token)] by unreleased.
release() performs the SafeMath addition on the released accounting.
The _released mapping value is the operand of the add() accounting update.
release() sets _lastRelease = block.timestamp.
release() executes the external ERC20 safeTransfer call after state updates.
The external token transfer can hand control to a malicious token contract able to re-enter release().
_token is the receiver of the safeTransfer call.
_beneficiary is the destination address of the token transfer.
The unreleased amount is the value transferred to the beneficiary.
_releasableAmount() checks block.timestamp - _lastRelease >= _month.
_lastRelease is the subtrahend in the unchecked timestamp subtraction.
_releasableAmount() performs block.timestamp - _lastRelease without SafeMath.
block.timestamp is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction, making the branch timestamp dependent.
_releasableAmount() subtracts _released[address(_token)] from the vested amount.
_vestedAmount() branches on block.timestamp versus _cliff and the vesting end time.
_token is the target contract of the balanceOf query.
_vestedAmount() performs the external _token.balanceOf(address(this)) call.
_vestedAmount() assigns currentBalance from the token balance query.
totalBalance = currentBalance.add(_released[address(_token)]).
Already released tokens are added to the current balance to form totalBalance.
_cliff is subtracted from block.timestamp in the vesting proportion computation.
block.timestamp drives the elapsed-time arithmetic in _vestedAmount().
_vestedAmount() computes block.timestamp.sub(_cliff).
totalBalance is multiplied by the elapsed time in the vested amount formula.
_releaseDuration is the divisor of the linear vesting formula.
_vestedAmount() performs totalBalance.mul(elapsed).div(_releaseDuration).
_cliffDuration contributes to the vesting end time compared in _vestedAmount().
_releaseDuration contributes to the vesting end time compared in _vestedAmount().
_month is included in the vesting end time used by _vestedAmount().
_month is the release interval threshold checked in _releasableAmount().
_start is used in the vesting end time computation.
_cliff is compared against block.timestamp and used in the vested proportion.
cliff() returns _cliff.
start() returns _start.
beneficiary() returns _beneficiary.
released() returns _released[address(_token)].
_token is the mapping key used by released() to read the accounting.
duration() returns _cliff + _releaseDuration.
_releaseDuration is added to _cliff in duration().

Temporary token balance read and consumed entirely within _vestedAmount().
